name: Lia Berlioz
source:
Lia is [url=/c1545]Elsterrier’s[/url] spunky, approachable best friend. She’s optimistic, speaks her mind, and easy to talk to. As the head of the newspaper club, she has connections and will be the first to know what’s the gossip around the island. She has a part-time job at a dusty, shut-in library and [url=/c10696]Kazuki[/url] sometimes help out whenever he needs cash. Coffee is the main drink there. When Lia sets her mind onto something, she will pursue it till the very end. Her Beltina dance is expressive and passionate but lacks control.

[From [url=http://verbalrubbish.oniichannoecchi.com/?p=4098&cpage=1#comment-107931]m3rryweather's review[/url]]
